description: The bar chart illustrates the Shapley values for different categories across three models: mBERT, XLM-R, and an unspecified model represented by a gray bar that is not labeled in the legend but is visible in the chart. The categories are listed on the horizontal axis, labeled as L4+, L3, L2, L1, T, R1, R2, R3, and R4+, in that order. The vertical axis represents the Shapley value, ranging from 0 to 80 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 20. Each category has three bars corresponding to the three models, colored light blue for mBERT, dark blue for XLM-R, and green for the third model. The bars for the categories L4+, L3, L2, L1, T, and R1 have varying heights, with the tallest bars being for category T, having approximate Shapley values of 58 for mBERT, 55 for XLM-R, and 78 for the green model. The bars for categories R2, R3, and R4+ are relatively short, with most having Shapley values close to 0 or slightly above. The bars within each category are grouped together, with the three models represented side by side. The chart does not display any specific sorting order for the bars beyond the categorical order on the horizontal axis, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color representation.
